app.title: Gfx Image Tool
app.tagline: Build embedded image headers entirely in your browser
app.privacy: Images stay in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
drop.title: Drop, paste, or choose images
drop.note: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WebP, .imagesconfig, or a project ZIP. Add several images to optimize one project.
project.title: Project settings
project.help: Choose the graphics library first. Start with automatic color treatment and the suggested pixel format.
images.title: Images
images.help: Sorted by filename. Dropping the same filename replaces its pixels and keeps its overrides.
images.computeError: This project could not be converted: {message}
error.tinyPaletteLimitTransparent: {image} cannot be converted as a TinyGFX RLE 4-bit palette image. It has {colors} converted colors ({visible} visible + 1 transparency key), but this format supports {limit} total. Set Color handling to Reduced palette color and Maximum colors to {suggested} or fewer, or set Pixel data format to Auto.
error.tinyPaletteLimitOpaque: {image} cannot be converted as a TinyGFX RLE 4-bit palette image. It has {colors} converted colors, but this format supports {limit} total. Set Color handling to Reduced palette color and Maximum colors to {suggested} or fewer, or set Pixel data format to Auto.
editor.title: Selected image
effective.title: Effective result
result.sourceAlpha: Source: {transparent}/{total} fully transparent pixels, {partial} partially transparent pixels.
result.sourceKey: Source key #{color} makes {count} additional pixels transparent.
result.sourceKeyNoMatch: Source key #{color} does not occur in the original; no pixels are made transparent.
result.outputAlpha: Final output: {transparent}/{total} pixels preserve the background.
result.outputOpaque: Final output: no transparency; every pixel is drawn.
result.bitmapTransparency: 1-bit transparency: zero bits preserve the background; one bits draw {foreground}.
result.unusedKey: A transparent value was specified, but it is unused because the final image has no transparent pixels.
result.unavailable: No final result is available until the conversion error is fixed.
report.title: Optimization report
report.help: Data is stored image/palette bytes. Decoder is code linked once per format. Project selection minimizes their total across all images.
report.none: Results appear after images are added.
export.title: Project files
export.sourcePreview: Original {type}, {width}×{height} pixels. This is a rebuild input under images/.
export.truncated: Preview truncated: {lines} lines in the complete file.
export.individualHelp: Optional exports for inspecting or using only the selected image.
export.note: The ZIP is a clean rebuildable project: the generated header is at its root, while original inputs and configuration stay under images/. Disposable tool caches are not included. Drop the ZIP here later to reopen it.
status.pickSourceColor: Click a pixel in the original preview to make that color transparent.
status.invalidProjectZip: The ZIP must contain images/.imagesconfig and original images under images/.
help.target: The C/C++ graphics library that will consume the generated data. It controls compatible formats and usage code.
help.mode: A user-facing quality choice. Automatic preserves color; monochrome and indexed modes deliberately reduce it.
help.format: The byte and bit layout stored in the header. Leave it automatic unless your drawing API requires one format.
help.colors: Maximum palette colors used by indexed conversion. Fewer colors can save space but may reduce quality.
help.dither: Uses pixel patterns to imitate missing colors. It may improve gradients but can make compression worse.
help.threshold: Brightness at which a pixel changes from black/off to white/on in 1-bit conversion.
help.alpha: Controls whether transparent source pixels preserve the background or are painted onto a matte.
help.alphaThreshold: Alpha values below this number become transparent when binary transparency is used.
help.alphaColor: One encoded color reserved to mean transparent. Auto avoids visible colors.
help.decoder: Estimated flash bytes for each TinyGFX decoder. The default 400 B is the project cost model.
help.prefer: Stable tie-break when horizontal and vertical 1-bit layouts have equal size.
help.vblit: Prefer vertical layout for TinyGFX's aligned fast drawing path. This is a speed/code-size choice.
help.prefix: Text added before every generated C/C++ symbol to avoid name collisions.
help.output: Filename of the bundled header inside generated output.
remove.title: Remove image?
remove.message: Remove {name} and its per-image settings from this browser project?
